area: Path analyzer: app service groups (endpoint_snapshots.py, vendor_endpoints.py, m365_endpoints.py, app_services.py, zia_path_modules.py, bulk_test.py, Advanced settings card)
title: App service groups out of the box: a dated excerpt of Microsoft's published Microsoft 365 list (version 2026043000, match only, expiring), no unchecked excerpts for other providers, GoTo's list fetchable, Zscaler's own groups unknown with the exact reason

checks.what: Microsoft 365 groups match a published destination from the bundled excerpt with nothing fetched, naming the excerpt, its version and when it was checked; Zoom, Webex, RingCentral, GoTo and Talkdesk ship no excerpt and stay unknown until a fetch or an import
An excerpt never yields no match; an expired excerpt (over 180 days) settles nothing
GoTo's JSON list: only address ranges taken; malformed JSON, private, over-broad or malformed ranges, too deep, too many values or over 1 MB refuse the whole list
No outbound request from matching, status or page load; GoTo is fetched only when switched on and Fetch now is clicked, from its one declared host, no redirect followed

Zscaler's own app service groups stay unknown, and the reason says the API lists them only by id and name (appServiceGroups/lite, appServices/lite) and never their members; the SDK fact (no call for either) is checked against the installed SDK

The Microsoft 365 excerpt is Microsoft's published version 2026043000 entry for entry: Teams media holds no 13.107.64.0/18, SharePoint is *.sharepoint.com, Teams and SharePoint carry UDP 443; dated by that version and checked date

findings.title: Microsoft 365 app service groups never matched out of the box (only after an opt-in fetch or an import); the other providers' groups still match only after a fetch (Zoom, GoTo) or an import, as no excerpt of their lists could be checked
findings.fix: endpoint_snapshots.py (bundled dated Microsoft 365 excerpt, match only), app_services.criterion/current, m365_endpoints and vendor_endpoints status

findings.title: GoTo publishes a machine-readable list but could only be imported by hand
findings.fix: vendor_endpoints PROVIDERS goto fetch, parse_json; Advanced settings switch advVendGotoOn; SECURITY.md and secure_by_design outbound line

findings.title: A bundled excerpt entry not in the provider's published list gives a false match (13.107.64.0/18 in Teams media; unchecked Zoom, Webex, RingCentral, GoTo and Talkdesk entries)
findings.fix: endpoint_snapshots.M365_SETS copied from Microsoft's version 2026043000; VENDOR emptied

findings.title: The reason shown for Zscaler's own groups said the API has no call that lists them; it has lite lists by id and name
